back: Absorption profit - marginal profit = (closing units - opening units) × fixed overhead absorbed per unit.
Absorption profit is higher: fixed overhead is carried forward in closing inventory.
Absorption profit is lower: fixed overhead from opening inventory is charged to cost of sales.
Over the whole life of a business total profit is the same under both methods; only the timing differs.
Absorption costing for published accounts (IAS 2) and full-cost pricing; marginal costing for decisions and performance measures.
Under absorption costing, producing for stock raises profit without extra sales; marginal costing removes this.
Use the fixed production overhead per unit, not the full unit cost, in the reconciliation.
